title: 第10章 来自Marin的认可
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

水晶爆炸的瞬间，现场的欢呼声轰然响起，隔着隔音耳机将里面原本平稳的白噪音都压了过去。

陈周抬手摘下耳机，耳膜因为声浪冲击而有些发闷。

舞台上方的聚光灯雪亮刺眼，将他眼前的视线晃得有些模糊。

而在被灯光照得通明的观众席上，粉丝正挥舞着手中的应援棒，大声高喊着“老干爹加油”，其中穿插着喊选手ID的声音。

最多的是Marin，其次是imp，零星能听到平野绫的声音。

至于他和Eimy则无人问津。

陈周撑着桌面站起身，长长地呼出了一口气。

直到这一刻，他的神经才终于在胜利的余温中稍微松弛了一点。

陈周自己清楚，整局的博弈过程到底有多凶险。

在这十年前的老旧版本里，他的对线期其实已经快要走到崩溃的边缘。

Easyhoon密不透风的对线压力，远比他预想中还要沉重，如果不是他凭借着后世看过无数场录像积累出来的读地图能力硬撑着，这把比赛他大概率会在前十分钟就被对面中野活活在塔下压死。

现在的他，在纯粹的操作和肌肉记忆上，终究还没能完全恢复到职业水准。

苦笑在嘴角一闪而逝，平野绫已经越过Eimy走到他身边，拍了拍他的肩膀，“陈周，干的漂亮！”

“下把我们稳点就2比0稳稳拿下了，”

平野绫很开心，天生“乐观”的他，也同样看到了希望。

Eimy没有多说什么，他紧紧跟在队友后面，朝着后台走去。

当推开休息室大门的那一瞬，屋子里的空气明显与比赛开始前发生了天翻地覆的变化。

压抑一扫而空，连呼吸都让人觉得轻快了几分。

imp已经回到了休息室的单人椅上。他随手点了根烟放松心情。

如果打比赛能抽烟，他的实力起码能再上一个台阶。

MaRin缓缓地从不远处的座位上站起身，穿过大半个房间，走到了陈周的面前。

这位来自韩国的世界顶级上单在陈周面前停下脚步，低头注视了陈周足足两秒钟，随后慢慢地抬起右手，竖起大拇指。

“Good.”

他的发音由于韩语习惯显得有些含混，但其中的赞赏之意却表达得清清楚楚。

坐在一旁的随队翻译都还没来得及开口组织措辞，陈周自己先愣了半秒。

因为这是MaRin来到LGD这支战队之后，破天荒第一次主动、正式地和他产生交流。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The moment the crystal exploded, cheers roared from the scene, and the sound-isolating headphones suppressed the originally steady white noise inside.

Chen Zhou raised his hand and took off his headphones. His eardrums were a little stuffy due to the impact of the sound waves.

The spotlight above the stage was bright and dazzling, blurring his vision.

In the brightly lit auditorium, fans were waving their support sticks and shouting "Come on, daddy", interspersed with calls for player IDs.

The most popular ones are Marin, followed by Imp, and Hirano Aya's voice can be heard sporadically.

As for him and Eimy, no one cares.

Chen Zhou stood up with support on the table and exhaled a long breath.

It wasn't until this moment that his nerves finally relaxed a little in the aftermath of victory.

Chen Zhou himself knew how dangerous the whole game process was.

In the old version from ten years ago, his laning period was actually on the verge of collapse.

Easyhoon's airtight laning pressure was far heavier than he expected. If he hadn't relied on his map-reading ability accumulated from watching countless videos in later generations, he would have been crushed to death by the opponent's midfielder under the tower in the first ten minutes of this game.

Now, in terms of pure operation and muscle memory, he has not yet fully returned to professional standards.

The bitter smile disappeared from the corner of her mouth. Hirano Aya had already passed Eimy and walked to him, patted his shoulder, "Chen Zhou, you did a great job!"

"We were more stable in the next game and won 2-0,"

Hirano Aya is very happy. He is naturally "optimistic" and also sees hope.

Eimy didn't say anything. He followed closely behind his teammates and walked backstage.

The moment the door to the lounge was opened, the atmosphere in the room had obviously changed drastically from before the game started.

The depression was gone, and even breathing felt a little lighter.

Imp has returned to the single chair in the lounge.He casually lit a cigarette to relax.

If he can smoke during games, his strength can at least reach another level.

MaRin slowly stood up from the seat not far away, walked through most of the room, and walked to Chen Zhou.

The world's top top laner from South Korea stopped in front of Chen Zhou, looked down at Chen Zhou for two seconds, then slowly raised his right hand and gave a thumbs up.

"Good."

His pronunciation was a little vague due to Korean habits, but his appreciation was clearly expressed.

Before the team translator sitting nearby could even formulate his words, Chen Zhou himself was stunned for half a second.

Because this is the first time MaRin has actively and formally communicated with him since he came to the LGD team.
